budget.metric: relative error of the simulated ISO 4287 roughness parameter (Ra, Rz) of the generated profile, evaluated with ISO 4288 cut-offs, against the measured value
budget.note: Replicate runs of one L36 plan differ by a median 5-8 % and up to 24-32 % (Khellaf 2026, computed here from the replicate pairs), the stated uncertainty of new-insert stylus Ra is 5-8 % (Magalhaes 2026), and ISO 4288 accepts a surface when up to 16 % of the readings exceed the limit, i.e. single readings scatter by about one standard deviation. At the small feeds of several cases the kinematic (feed-mark) part is a fraction of the measured value (Magalhaes 2026, Sultana 2023), so the minimum-chip-thickness, ploughing and vibration contributions decide the result. 30 % is about twice the replicate scatter and the band in which a kinematic model with the minimum chip thickness (Brammertz 1961, Grzesik 1996) can be expected to stay; larger misses mean a missing mechanism.
